The Shul'ka, Hunters of Shadows, are a group of haranir hunters, healers, and guides, that have sacrificed everything to protect the haranir and to defend Harandar against the horrors found within the Rift of Aln. As the echoes of their Goddess's anguish there drive most haranir mad, the Shul'ka silence their connection to her in order to safely patrol the Rift. Haranir who enter the rift will succumb and die within minutes without protection. Haranir who survive their ritual and are successful in becoming Shul'ka, enter a "sort of" self-exile in which they must remain in the Rift of Aln; occasionally they visit or are visited by friends and family.

The siege of the Sunwell was a major battle between the Vanguard of the Light and the Devouring Host over control of Sunwell Plateau. This battle served as the opening engagement of the War of Light and Shadow in Quel'Thalas when the Vanguard interceded in aid of the Sin'dorei armies. While many of the local defenders were slain in battle, the Vanguard of the Light was successfully able to establish a lasting defensive front around the Sunwell itself and deter the Devouring Host for a time, granting time for their forces to defend the rest of Quel'thalas from invasion and prepare for a counterattack into the Voidstorm from which the Host emerged.

The Signet of the Silver Covenant is a non-equippable ring in World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King Classic. It is provided to Alliance players who activate a Titan Rune Dungeon with its highest-level Protocol Gamma setting. Using it summons a Silver Covenant Warden who grants access to a choice of four buffs to aid the player while completing the dungeon. Its Horde counterpart is the Signet of the Sunreaver.

.]] The silver hand (occasionally Silver Hand or Silver Fist) is a symbol of the titanic keeper Tyr, derived from the literal prosthetic hand of pure silver with which he replaced his left hand after it was severed by Galakrond. This silver hand was forged by Tyr's friend, Jotun, and came to symbolize the keeper's belief that true justice can only be accomplished through personal sacrifice. Following Tyr's ultimate sacrifice and death in his battle against Zakajz the Corruptor, his silver hand was placed atop his resting place in Tirisfal Glades, where it was watched over by his vrykul followers before mysteriously disappearing millennia later. Together, they killed many kobyss and stole their staves to stop their necromancy. However, Theleon fell in battle when they went to kill the kobyss leading the attacks.
